reader_notes.text: Or 'the virgin.' The Hebrew word here is עַלְמָה ('young woman'); the Greek Septuagint renders it with a word often understood as 'virgin,' and Matthew 1:23 cites the verse in that form.

Or the young woman will conceive and bear a son. The Hebrew presents pregnancy and bearing; their time reference depends on context. The main text takes pregnancy as present and birth as future, but pregnancy may also be understood prospectively.
Or 'you shall call his name,' reflected in some ancient versional traditions; Matthew 1:23 has 'they shall call his name.'
